collection.description: A villager sees dolphins playing just offshore: swim towards them, or hang back.
approximations: 'loses 30 to 50% health' is a health change of -30..-50 points (the engine clamps at 1: never dies from it)

intro.text: (Subject) has been swimming underwater as a hobby. One day, (subject.he/she) spots a pod of dolphins playing just offshore! They seem to be chasing something, but (subject) is unsure whether (subject.he/she) can hold (subject.his/her) breath long enough to see what. What should (subject.he/she) do?

swim.text: (subject) swims towards the dolphins, being careful not to disturb them.

hunt.text:
(subject.He/She) gleefully watches the clever dolphins herd shoals of fish through giant bubble rings, disorienting them enough to become easy prey. "What magnificent creatures!" (subject.he/she) thinks.
Later, (subject.he/she) shares (subject.his/her) observations with the researchers and farmers, which revolutionize their catches that season. (subject) becomes a skilled fisher(subject.man/woman) and is lauded as a pioneer of aquaculture. Your villagers gain (award) food.

slap.text: Ouch! (subject) is blinded by the slap of a large fluke in (subject.his/her) face. (subject.He/She) must have gotten too close to one of them and accidentally gotten hit by their tail flipper. (subject) holds (subject.his/her) nose to prevent any more red coming out. Luckily, (subject) is not too far from the surface, but if (subject.he/she) had been any deeper... (subject.he/she) shudders to think about what might happen. (subject.He/She) surfaces, leaves the beach, and heads off to the doctors for some medical treatment.

hang.text: (subject) doubts that it's a good idea to follow the dolphins. They clearly seem to be busy doing something important, and (subject.he/she) is second-guessing whether they're playing anyway. (subject) resolves to stick to the shallows and gather shellfish and seaweed on the nearby rocks. Your village gains (award) food.
